detail.case: Cyrillic С in USDС normalises to USDC
zero-width space inside U​SDC is removed
combining acute on U is stripped
look-alike by first 4 + last 4 names the payee

fan_in.note: AMLSim fan-in: several members pay the main account the same amount; the ledger has no fan-in detector

fan_out.note: AMLSim fan-out: the main account pays several members the same amount

cycle.note: AMLSim cycle: money goes round a ring of members, each keeping a margin; no cycle detector in the ledger

bipartite.note: AMLSim bipartite: every originator pays every beneficiary

stack.note: AMLSim stack: two bipartite layers, originators to intermediaries to beneficiaries

random.note: AMLSim random: a chain of members, one amount, one day

scatter_gather.note: AMLSim scatter-gather: fan-out to intermediaries, then fan-in to one beneficiary

gather_scatter.note: AMLSim gather-scatter: fan-in to one intermediary, then fan-out

drain.note: a sudden payment far above the wallet's history, to a stranger

drain_small.note: a drain below the $250 floor; by design not flagged

drain_known_payee.note: a drain to an address the wallet had paid before; the rule requires a stranger

slow_drain.note: the wallet is emptied in 4 payments, each under 5x the previous largest, to one sink

routing_hop_large.note: $1700 in and out in one transaction; excluded from spending by the pass-through rule, so no drain flag

retry_storm.note: 61 payments to one seller inside 10 minutes

retry_storm_slow.note: 58 payments to one seller over 25 minutes; outside the 10-minute window

retry_storm_straddle.note: 54 payments inside 10 minutes that cross an hour boundary; the hour buckets each hold fewer than 50

mint_burst.note: 88 registrations minted by one address inside an hour; a shape, not a harm

mint_burst_spread.note: 35 registrations by one address over 3 hours, each hour under 25

uri_timeout_streak.note: 8 failed probes and never one that answered

uri_flapping.note: 9 failed probes with one success among them; not a streak by definition

funding_quiet.note: funded after registration and never pays; the ladder must leave it at L0
